name: the original defect: any non-zero exit from `sbx policy check` read as unknown (a real denial exits 1)
new: out=$(sbx policy check network --sandbox "$NAME" "$1" </dev/null 2>&1) || { echo unknown; return; }; rc=0

name: Allowed with a failing exit is an allow
Denied at any exit status is a denial (a crash or exit 2 is not an answer)
Denied at exit 0 is unknown (only exit 1 reads as a denial)
an unreadable answer (empty output, a crash) is read as a denial
an unreadable answer is read as an allow
egress check: a verdict sbx will not give returns 1, not 2
egress check: a violation returns 2, not 1
status: a violation reads egress=ok
old: case $? in 0) egress=ok ;; 1) egress=WRONG ;; *) egress=unknown ;; esac
new: case $? in 0) egress=ok ;; 1) egress=ok ;; *) egress=unknown ;; esac

name: status: an unreadable verdict reads egress=ok
old: case $? in 0) egress=ok ;; 1) egress=WRONG ;; *) egress=unknown ;; esac
new: case $? in 0) egress=ok ;; 1) egress=WRONG ;; *) egress=ok ;; esac

name: status: a clean policy reads egress=WRONG
old: case $? in 0) egress=ok ;; 1) egress=WRONG ;; *) egress=unknown ;; esac
new: case $? in 0) egress=WRONG ;; 1) egress=WRONG ;; *) egress=unknown ;; esac
